pass_through.origin|dex.intear.near.note: Design 2.1: traced out it passes money through, traced in it was a counterparty. It is a router.

pass_through.origin|meteor-relayer.near.note: Design 2.1: a relayer in detect and trace, missing from origin.

pass_through.origin|relay.aurora.note: Design 2.1: a relayer in detect and trace, missing from origin.

pass_through.trace|system.note: Design 2.1: the system account is pass-through in detect and origin, missing from trace (it never appears in traced flows, so no behaviour changes).

pass_through.origin|aurora.note: The Aurora engine is pass-through everywhere (since PR #74): money sent there leaves NEAR, and drain detection must never treat an exchange's bridge deposit as a drain. The old origin/trace lists lacked it.

pass_through.trace|aurora.note: The Aurora engine is pass-through everywhere (since PR #74): money sent there leaves NEAR, and drain detection must never treat an exchange's bridge deposit as a drain. The old origin/trace lists lacked it.

tracer.pass_through|aurora.note: The Aurora engine is pass-through everywhere (since PR #74): money sent there leaves NEAR, and drain detection must never treat an exchange's bridge deposit as a drain. The old origin/trace lists lacked it.
